source_convention: The authored weapon tip points right; the cutting edge lies below the blade face. ACT rotation is clockwise on screen.

edge_side_correction.reason: These attacks sweep counterclockwise from overhead toward lower-left. The previous edge side led with the spine. R(theta+180)*mirrorX equals R(theta)*mirrorY, preserving the tip axis while reversing the cutting-edge side.
edge_side_correction.unchanged_direction: S attacks sweep clockwise toward lower-right and retain their edge side.

basis: Visual review of all five authored six-pose attack sheets and decoded before/after composites. Adjusted winding/overhead blade axes to follow the stacked fists.

validation.mirrored_hand_transform: Numerically checked: horizontal reflection preserves Y and negates X.
validation.gui_execution: Root reviewed 22 offline captures using the existing release renderer and installed v2 overlay: both weapons ready/side/attack plus Muramasa windup/strike in all eight directions. Renderer matches decoded contacts and corrected hand/edge orientation. No live login.

review_artifacts: target/weapon-pose-audit/{S,SW,W,NW,N}.png; diagnostic outputs are not release inputs.

ready_pose_edge_side_correction.reason: The ready stance raised the blade with a plain rotation, which turned the cutting edge and the angled kissaki to face up. The mirrored form keeps the same tip direction and grip with the edge underneath.
ready_pose_edge_side_correction.unchanged_directions: S (310) and N (315) already keep the edge underneath.
ready_pose_edge_side_correction.review: Offline captures of the ready pose: Kusanagi in SW, W, NW, NE, E and SE; Muramasa and the starter katana in SW and W.

offhand_cross_slash.request: Dual wielding Kusanagi and Muramasa; the blades make a cross slash, slashing in opposite directions of each other.
offhand_cross_slash.grip: Main-hand grip + (2, 0): the body art holds one katana in stacked fists.
offhand_cross_slash.edge_side: Counter-clockwise cuts (S) mirror=true, rotation=(tip+180)%360; clockwise cuts are plain rotations, so the edge leads. N ready is mirrored (tip up-left, edge outward).
offhand_cross_slash.visibility: Facing away (NW, N) the off-hand blade is drawn behind the body like the main one; angles were chosen so it clears the head. No tip ends more than 2 px below the ground line.
offhand_cross_slash.basis: Decoded composites of body + off-hand + main in all eight directions (mirrored NE/E/SE reflect automatically).
offhand_cross_slash.validation: Offline captures at prt_fild08, 2000x1125, distance 300, Kusanagi right and Muramasa left: ready S, attack frame 4 facing S, E and NE, frame 3 facing W and N. Live login as Hayate (Kusanagi right, Muramasa left equipped on the server): the client resolved the left hand as item 900002 and loaded muramasa_offhand; a capture while attacking shows both blades in the ready stance.
